rules.when: a simple, unambiguous chore: a small fix with a known cause, a documentation update, a rename, a config tweak

ops, browser or terminal automation: driving a browser or CLI against an external system, deploying, merging, running or checking jobs, anything where the work is operating tools rather than writing code
simple research: look something up, summarize a file or a repository area, answer a bounded factual question
in-depth research or detailed technical planning: architecture, design documents, reviews, investigations with judgement calls
coding or implementation: writing or changing code, tests, or scripts beyond a trivial chore

fleet.charter: Work on the Fleet project itself at ~/development/fleet. Nothing unrelated to that project.

openclaw.charter: Work on the user's OpenClaw setup: the ~/development/openclaw repository, its skills, gateway and browser automation, and incidents or post-mortems under ~/.openclaw/workspace. Nothing unrelated to OpenClaw.
